name: Gästehaus Glätzle
beschreibung:
Quietly and sunnily located in Zoeblen, Gaestehaus Glaetzle offers well-tended guestrooms and holiday flats. The majestic high valley scenery creates a perfect setting for year-round mountain holidays.

The Rohnenlift ski lift, cross-country trail network, and scenic walking trails are right outside.
kurzbeschreibung: Gaestehaus Glaetzle in Zoeblen features family hospitality in the stunning Tannheimer Tal valley.
